notes: Drive times are Bardolino-relative, dry weather, off-peak. Add 10–20 minutes on SR249 in high-season late morning.
Venice access is stubbed here; venice_plan.json owns the mode decision.

destinations.name: Venice
destinations.route_summary: Research stub: car only as far as Peschiera (or lagoon garages). See venice_plan.json.

lots.name: Tronchetto / Piazzale Roma (if driving to the lagoon)
lots.notes: Not recommended for this family; listed for comparison.

parking.ztl_warning: Historic Venice is car-free. Do not follow GPS into ZTL on the mainland approaches.
parking.fill_time: Station parking usually feasible if you arrive before 08:00; lagoon garages can queue in peak.

baby.changing: Santa Lucia station toilets; large cafe WCs
baby.shade: Limited in campos; seek arcade cafes
baby.feeding: Cafes with indoor seats; not San Marco steps

stroller.notes: 400+ stepped bridges. Carrier is the plan.

walking.notes: Flat stones, punishing bridges. Keep the loop small.

food: Cicchetti in a quiet San Polo bacaro, not the Rialto elbow
Sit-down trattoria away from the bridge
Station-area cafe if the baby needs an immediate pause
destinations.safety: Very touristy; pickpockets at Rialto/San Marco. Otherwise standard historic-city safety. Prefer daytime, which this itinerary already enforces.
unsuitable_if: Weekend in peak season if you can shift to a weekday

destinations.name: Lake Garda ferry loop (Bardolino–Garda–Torri)
destinations.route_summary: Apartment to Bardolino imbarcadero. Passenger boats on Navigazione Laghi. Car stays home.

parking.backup_lot: Bardolino centro paid lots a few minutes walk
parking.fill_time: Boat queues matter more than car parks

baby.changing: Bardolino cafes before boarding; limited on boats
baby.shade: Sit inside the cabin if the deck is harsh sun or wind
baby.feeding: Before boarding and in Torri piazzetta

stroller.notes: Fold for gangways. Carrier during boarding.

beaches: Optional Baia delle Sirene only if energy and parking/taxi allow — not required
food: Torri del Benaco lakeside trattoria (inland tables if the front is a trap)
Garda town coffee on the waterfront
Gelato back in Bardolino
destinations.safety: Secure tourist harbors. Main risk is wet gangways and cancelled boats in wind.

costs_eur.ferry: medium-route pair ~€6–12 adult each way band

unsuitable_if: Baby with acute ear issues (ask a doctor)

destinations.name: Parco Giardino Sigurtà and Borghetto sul Mincio
destinations.route_summary: South via Lazise and Peschiera, then inland to Valeggio sul Mincio.

lots.name: Parco Giardino Sigurtà lots (Rosso/Giallo) + village lots for Borghetto
lots.cost_eur: Park parking typically free/unattended ~600 m; village cheap/free signed lots
lots.notes: This is the parking win of the holiday.

parking.backup_lot: Italmark / via Cavour area lots in Valeggio
parking.fill_time: Tulip season weekends fill; ordinary summer mornings are civilised

baby.changing: Park toilets including accessible WCs on the main circuit
baby.feeding: Benches, picnic lawns, restaurant at/near park

stroller.notes: Porphyry and compact paths. Panoramic train is a rest option. No stroller rental — bring yours.

walking.notes: Do a short garden loop + train, not all 10 km of avenues. Borghetto is a 20–30 minute village amble.

food: Tortellini di Valeggio in town (broth or butter/sage)
Park cafe for a short feed
Borghetto river-view lunch if you booked or arrived early
unsuitable_if: Monday restaurant closures for the lunch half

destinations.name: Peschiera del Garda
destinations.route_summary: SR249 south along the lake through Cisano and Lazise.

lots.name: Parcheggio Fortezza / wall-side lots
lots.notes: Far easier than Sirmione. Arrive morning.

parking.backup_lot: Station-area parking if visiting both town and later trains

baby.changing: Cafes and lido facilities in season

stroller.notes: Best 'water town' stroller day on the lake if you stay on the main fortress circuit.

walking.notes: Do not add a countryside hike. Walls + harbor + lido is enough.

beaches: Lidos on the south/east edges — pebble/concrete family beaches, not Caribbean sand
food: Gelato on the fortress bridges
Simple lakeside lunch away from the busiest corner
Coffee near Porta Verona
destinations.safety: Busy but standard family tourist town. Watch bike traffic on the walls.
unsuitable_if: You already spent the morning here parking for Venice — do not double it the same day

destinations.name: Sirmione
destinations.route_summary: South to Peschiera then across toward the peninsula. Last kilometres crawl.

lots.name: Parcheggio Monte Baldo
lots.notes: Largest lot opposite the castle approach. Fills by ~10:00 in summer.

lots.name: Parcheggio Marconi
lots.notes: Closest to ZTL. Tiny. Goes first.

parking.backup_lot: Colombare overflow — cheaper/free-ish, ~18 minute flat walk
parking.ztl_warning: Historic centre ZTL year-round, cameras 24/7. Day visitors do not drive past the castle bridge.

stroller.notes: Cobbles and people. Grotte di Catullo walk is too long/hot for this brief.

walking.notes: Castle + old town only. Skip Grotte di Catullo.

beaches: Lido delle Bionde / Jamaica beach area — further down the peninsula, extra walking
food: Old-town restaurants are fine if you sit; prices and crowds are the tax
destinations.safety: Secure, extremely crowded. ZTL fines are the family risk.

destinations.name: Lazise

lots.name: Signed edge-of-centre lots (follow P toward walls)
lots.notes: Harbor itself is not where you want to hunt for a bay.

parking.backup_lot: Further inland supermarket lots with a 10–12 min walk

stroller.notes: Old town compact and mostly manageable.

walking.notes: Harbor + walls. Do not treat as a full 'away day' if you already live 12 minutes north.

beaches: Small lido patches south of town
food: Harbor is pretty and average; one street back is better
unsuitable_if: You need a destination that feels different from Bardolino

destinations.name: Garda and Punta San Vigilio

lots.name: Baia delle Sirene / Punta San Vigilio paid parking
lots.notes: Underpass to the bay. Fills. Garda town lots are the fallback, skipping the bay.

parking.backup_lot: Garda town parking, enjoy the harbor instead of the bay

baby.changing: Bay services in season; otherwise Garda cafes
baby.shade: Olives at the bay — a plus

stroller.notes: Lot to bay is short; pebble shore wants a carrier.

food: Bay bar/restaurant in season
Garda town squares
destinations.safety: Secure. Drowning/pebble entry is the practical risk, not crime.

destinations.name: Torri del Benaco (by car)
destinations.route_summary: North via Garda on SR249. Prefer the ferry loop instead of driving this.

lots.name: Harbor / castle-adjacent signed lots
lots.notes: Tighter than Peschiera. Ferry removes the problem.

parking.backup_lot: Upper town lots with a walk down

stroller.notes: Harbor yes; castle interior stairs no.

food: Harbor trattorie; look inland one street
unsuitable_if: Already doing the ferry loop — do not also drive here the next morning

destinations.name: Malcesine
destinations.route_summary: North along the east shore. Pretty and slow.

lots.name: Large peripheral lots + shuttle/walk to centre
lots.cost_eur: hourly, can be steep near centre
lots.notes: Centre is tight. Cable-car area queues.

stroller.notes: Hills, castle, crowds. Cable car not a newborn need.

food: Tourist-heavy harbour
unsuitable_if: Infant day — travel effort and crowds

destinations.name: Riva del Garda
destinations.route_summary: North to the head of the lake. Against the 2h cap on a bad traffic day.

lots.name: Large edge lots (e.g. via Monte Oro area class)

parking.backup_lot: Torbole lots — not closer to a stroller rest

stroller.notes: Promenade is fine; the day is long.

food: Strong cafe culture

destinations.name: Desenzano del Garda
destinations.route_summary: South and around the bottom of the lake.

lots.name: Harbor / castle-area signed garages and lots
lots.notes: A real town, more infrastructure than villages.

food: Broader restaurant range than Bardolino harbor
destinations.safety: Larger town, still standard tourist Italy.
unsuitable_if: You already have a beach day at Peschiera

destinations.name: Salò
destinations.route_summary: Around the south or via Maderno traghetto with the car — the traghetto is a separate logistics problem with an infant.

stroller.notes: One of the better west-shore stroller promenades.

food: Strong, more local-Italian than east-shore tourist strips
unsuitable_if: Drive time vs. payoff with a newborn

destinations.name: Verona
destinations.route_summary: Inland via Calmasino / A22 or local roads to the city.

lots.name: Arena / centro garages (e.g. Cittadella class)
lots.notes: Do not enter ZTL. Follow garage signs only.

stroller.notes: Marble and cobbles. Carrier better in the Arena area crush.

walking.notes: Easy to overdo. Rainy-day candidate, not a scored winner.

food: Excellent, if you sit down away from Casa di Giulietta
destinations.safety: Pickpockets in peak spots. Otherwise ordinary city.

destinations.name: Cisano / Bardolino beaches
destinations.route_summary: Local lake road. Rest-day, not one of the four trips.

stroller.notes: Best stroller infrastructure of the trip: your own lungolago.

food: Apartment kitchen
Bardolino inland trattoria at dinner
unsuitable_if: Counted as a 'day trip' — it is not
